en: A vintage postcard showing a large building complex set in a mountainous landscape, straddling a river with a bridge. There are two main buildings, one labeled as 'COMANO.' The text 'Bagni di Comano.' is printed at the bottom in red, indicating the location, with 'Mass. Marchetto-Trento.' in smaller font below. The setting appears serene, with forested hills, a waterway, and old stone structures, typical of early 20th-century spa or bathing resorts.
